rule.description: A locally defined contract trait with at least four explicit function items (required or defaulted) forces implementors and erased consumers to depend on capability surface they never use: implementors never call members on themselves that no erased consumer calls either, and erased consumers call only a subset of the contract.

checks.description: Detect implementor types forced to provide contract members that neither the implementation itself nor any erased consumer of the contract ever uses.
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The implementor's dependency boundary is set by the whole contract rather than by what the concrete relationship actually consumes, so the type carries capability answers for a role it does not perform.

matches.evidence: The push implementation answers remote-to-local exclusion, pull compression, pull mode and remote command synthesis for the RemoteOperation contract; push only moves files local to remote and nothing in the implementation or the erased consumers calls those members.

The pull implementation answers local-to-remote exclusion, push compression and remote command synthesis for the RemoteOperation contract; pull only moves files remote to local and never uses those members.

The remote command implementation answers both exclusion directions, both compression levels and pull mode for the RemoteOperation contract; it executes a command over ssh and moves no files, and none of those members is used.

checks.description: Detect consumers that are parameterized over the contract (generic bounds elaborated through marker subtraits, or trait objects) and call only a subset of its capability surface.
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The consumer's dependency is routed through an interface far wider than the responsibility it exercises, so the erased call boundary depends on capabilities the call sites never reach.

matches.evidence: execute_transfer accepts any operation through the marker-bounded contract but performs only prepare, run and finish; the nine transfer-direction, command and description members of the elaborated contract stay unused.
start_transfer accepts any operation through the marker-bounded contract but performs only prepare and run, leaving finish and the direction/command/description members unused.
prepare_and_start_command accepts any command operation through the marker-bounded contract but performs only prepare and run, leaving finish and the direction/command/description members unused.
complete consolidates through a RemoteOperation trait object but calls only finish, so every other member of the erased contract is part of its dependency without being used.

excluded: FileTransferOperation and CommandOperation (src/operation.rs): local marker traits with no explicit function items; the rule only analyzes contracts with at least four explicit function items and reaches them solely by elaborating the contract they refine.

OperationSignal and OperationOutcome (src/operation.rs): lifecycle result carriers defined as a pair of inherent methods on one type and a plain data struct, not contracts; they impose no implementable capability surface, so no implementor or consumer is forced to depend on them by a trait bound and they take part in no matched relation.
PullMode (src/sync.rs): a configuration enum, not a contract; it provides no capability surface for implementors or consumers.
Test modules under #[cfg(test)]: not production surface.
